purpose: SITL AirSim battery re-initialises its state of charge when SIM_BATT_VOLTAGE or SIM_BATT_CAP_AH changes, so a landed fleet can be refilled from Mission Control without restarting the coupled world.
reset_procedure: Fleet.reset_batteries: every drone landed and disarmed; SIM_BATT_VOLTAGE 12.61 then 12.6; MAV_CMD_BATTERY_RESET (1, 100); wait for SYS_STATUS battery_remaining 100.
runtime_env: SNR_SITL_BINARY updated in deploy/runtime.env.example and .local/runtime.env; snr-mission restart required to load it.
